mapper.select: SELECT session_id, transcript_path FROM hook_session WHERE transcript_path IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_observed_at, session_id_sha256
SELECT * FROM source_file WHERE path_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{path}, 256)) AND path=#{path}
SELECT id, parse_status, raw_text FROM raw_jsonl_record WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY generation, byte_offset
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transcript_binding(session_id, configured_path, canonical_path, path_status, source_file_id, session_meta_record_id, jsonl_session_id, session_check_status, adapter_version, checked_at) VALUES(#{sessionId},#{configuredPath},#{canonicalPath},#{pathStatus},#{sourceFileId},#{sessionMetaRecordId}, #{jsonlSessionId},#{sessionCheckStatus},#{adapterVersion},#{checkedAt}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE configured_path=incoming.configured_path, canonical_path=incoming.canonical_path, path_status=incoming.path_status, source_file_id=incoming.source_file_id, session_meta_record_id=incoming.session_meta_record_id, jsonl_session_id=incoming.jsonl_session_id, session_check_status=incoming.session_check_status, adapter_version=incoming.adapter_version, checked_at=incoming.checked_at
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, configured_path, canonical_path, path_status, source_file_id, session_meta_record_id, jsonl_session_id, session_check_status, adapter_version, checked_at FROM transcript_binding ORDER BY checked_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jsonl_supplement(hook_node_type,hook_node_id,raw_record_id,content_kind,call_id, mapping_level,evidence_json,adapter_version,content_text) VALUES(#{supplement.hookNodeType},#{supplement.hookNodeId},#{supplement.rawRecordId}, #{supplement.contentKind},#{supplement.callId},#{supplement.mappingLevel},#{evidenceJson}, #{supplement.adapterVersion},#{supplement.contentText}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=jsonl_supplement.id
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.hook_node_type, s.hook_node_id, s.raw_record_id, s.content_kind, s.call_id, s.mapping_level, s.adapter_version, s.content_text, r.raw_text raw_json FROM jsonl_supplement s JOIN raw_jsonl_record r ON r.id=s.raw_record_id WHERE (s.hook_node_type='TURN' AND s.hook_node_id=#{turnId}) OR (s.hook_node_type='TOOL' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM hook_tool_call h WHERE h.turn_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(#{turnId}, 256)) AND h.turn_id=#{turnId} AND h.tool_use_id_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(s.hook_node_id, 256)) AND h.tool_use_id=s.hook_node_id)) ORDER BY r.event_time, r.id, s.id
